issue.title: util: Make files opened via `fsbridge::fopen()` not inheritable by child processes
issue.body:
Files opened via [`fsbridge::fopen()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/dd9d2b919d6a97907417bf9c4f539f182f04cc01/src/util/fs.cpp#L23-L30) are inherited by child processes, such as `-*notify` or `-signer` commands.

They should not be, as a child has no business with the node's open files. On POSIX systems this can be achieved with `O_CLOEXEC`. On Windows, with the `N` mode flag (`_O_NOINHERIT`).

On Windows, this manifests as a functional test that passes all its cases and then fails to clean up:
```
PermissionError: [WinError 32] The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process: ‘D:\a\temp\test_runner₿🏃20261026_100424\feature_versionbits_warning_0\node0\regtest\debug.log’
```

Previously reported in #28529 and #27352.
